interpretation_scope: Differentiable action sensitivity of the latent forecast (no donor, no candidate-action pair). Relational = hazard-induced change of the action Jacobian minus the matched off-path (H0') change. Step 0 is primary; k >= 1 is autoregressive. Checkpoint jepa_wm_droid is DROID-only (vendored training config droid_4fpcs_fps4_r256_dv3vitl_asp1_pred_AdaLN_depth12_noprop_repro_2roll_4n.yaml: datasets: [DROID], override_datasets: true); the RoboCasa contact stimuli are zero-shot for this model.

aliases.gripper: (empty: no manipulator in the driving scene)

token_group_source.masks: hazard_mask (pedestrian or cone) and corridor_mask (ego-lane polygon ahead), [T,256,256] bool
